title: ControlsFile
description:
`controls.yaml`: the cockpit's zones, the controls steps refer to, and the overview map
that shows where each zone is.

controls.description: Every control a step or panel item names.

overview.description: The cockpit overview: the step map and the Flight deck page. Without it, neither shows a map.

Control.description: A switch, lever or other control a step refers to.

function.description:
What the control does; shown in a step's context, and for a panel item with no
`description` of its own.

id.description: The control's id, which steps list in `controls` and panel items in theirs.

location.description:
Where the control is, in words; shown with it in Find and in a step's context, and in
Practice's answers.

name.description:
What the control is called ("Fuel pump switches"), as Find and a panel item's card
show it.

plural.description: The name is plural ("Fuel pump switches"): Practice asks "Where are the …?".

zone.description: Absent for controls with no place in the cockpit, such as a briefing.

LabelAnchor.description: Which way a label runs from its point.

oneOf.description: The label starts at its point.
The label is centered on its point; the default.
The label ends at its point.

Overview.description: A schematic of the whole cockpit, in our own layout.

height.description: The overview's height in its own units.

regions.description: The parts of the cockpit a step map shows one at a time.

width.description: The overview's width in its own units; every region lies inside it.

OverviewArea.description: A rectangle on the cockpit overview map. A zone can have several.

height.description: The rectangle's height, in the overview's units.

label.description: Overrides the zone's short title on the map.

width.description: The rectangle's width, in the overview's units.

x.description:
The rectangle's left edge, in the overview's units. Its center decides which region it
belongs to.

y.description: The rectangle's top edge, in the overview's units.

zone.description: The zone this rectangle stands for.

OverviewRegion.description:
A part of the cockpit on the overview map, e.g. the forward overhead panel. A map of one
region shows the areas whose centers fall inside its rectangle (the first region that
holds them), with its captions around the edges.

bottom.description: The caption for the bottom edge.

bottom_short.description: The short caption for the bottom edge; the long one when left out.

code.description: A short reference shown after the name, e.g. "P5".

height.description: The region's height, in the overview's units; more than 0.

left.description: The caption for the left edge.

left_short.description: The short caption for the left edge; the long one when left out.

locate.description: Where to look from the seat, for "Where is this?".

name.description:
The region's name, unique among regions; side and seat view places name it as their
`region`, and the maps use it as their name.

right.description: The caption for the right edge.

right_short.description: The short caption for the right edge; the long one when left out.

short.description:
The area's short name, e.g. "Overhead", where a picture of a flow names the areas;
regions may share one. Without it, the name.

short_title.description: The shorter Where is this? title, for phones; the whole one when left out.

title.description:
The Where is this? title, as a whole question ("Where is the forward overhead
panel?"), and the shorter one phones use ("Where is the forward overhead?").

top.description: Captions for the edges, saying which way each faces.

top_short.description:
Short edge captions for the small step map ("AFT", "FORWARD", "CAPT", "F/O"); the
long ones stay for the Flight deck page.

width.description: The region's width, in the overview's units; more than 0.

x.description:
The region's left edge, in the overview's units. Its rectangle lies inside the overview
and holds the areas whose centers fall in it.

y.description: The region's top edge, in the overview's units.

OverviewViews.description: The side and seat views for "Where is this?", and the top view for the exterior inspection.

seat.description: The view from the seat: one frame, or one per seat.

side.description: The view from the side, with the sight line from the eye.

top.description:
The airplane from above, nose up, for the exterior inspection (decision 0032): `structure`
and `glass` shapes and labels, no places. Steps' `walkaround` points are in its units.

SeatViews.description:
The seat view: one frame, or one per seat, keyed by the seat ids the pack's labels list
(decision 0029).

anyOf.description: One frame, whichever seat the pilot is in.
A frame per seat, keyed by seat id.

ViewFrame.description:
A side or seat view of the flight deck (decision 0023), or the top view of the airplane
(decision 0032), in its own units.

height.description: The view's height in its own units.

labels.description: Fixed labels drawn in the view.

places.description: Where each overview region sits in the view.

shapes.description: The airplane's shapes: structure, glass, seat and eye.

width.description: The view's width in its own units; every point in it is inside.

ViewLabel.description: A fixed label in a side or seat view, e.g. "WINDSHIELD" or "CABIN →".

anchor.description: Which way the text runs from its point.

text.description: The label's text, drawn as written.

x.description: Its point across, in the view's units.

y.description: Its point down, in the view's units.

ViewPlace.description: Where one overview region sits in a side or seat view: one or more closed outlines.

label_at.description: Where the region's name goes when it is the one shown, if the view names it.

names.description:
For a region drawn as several outlines, each outline's name on the Flight deck page,
front to back ("Forward electronic"); without them, its places' area names as written.

shapes.description: The region's closed outlines, each a list of `[x, y]` points in the view's units.

ViewRole.description:
How the renderer draws a shape in a side, seat or top view (decisions 0023 and 0032). Roles
name no aircraft part, so any pack can draw its own airplane.

oneOf.description:
The airplane's outline (fuselage, walls; from above, also the wings, tail and engines):
filled.
Where the pilot's eyes are: one point. The side view's sight line starts here.

ViewShape.description:
One shape in a side, seat or top view: an outline through its points (a curve is given as many
points), closed when `closed`. An `eye` is one point.

closed.description: The outline joins its last point back to its first.

points.description: The points the outline runs through, `[x, y]` in the view's units.

area.description:
The part of the cockpit the zone is in ("Overhead"), shown before its title ("Overhead
· Fuel"); without overview regions, the step map shows the zones of the same area.

id.description: The zone's id, which controls name as their `zone` and overview areas as theirs.

position.description:
Where the zone sits in its area, for the step map's position line ("Captain side,
row nearest the windshield").

short_title.description: The zone's label on the overview map's boxes, in capitals, unless an area gives its own.

title.description: The zone's name, shown where a control's place is given and on the Flight deck page.
